purpose: Provide one owner-local deterministic self-validation surface for the transversal GATE_CHECK_OBSERVABILITY capability so PASE can execute its own package checks without using Validate LF Packs as the execution owner.

qualification_boundary.reason: Historical Validate LF Packs qualification is coupled to Profile Runtime evidence and must not be silently re-homed before an independent reusable contract is proven.

ownership_invariants: Applicability is decided upstream; this runner only executes the owner package checks.
The runner executes the canonical run_gate_checks_v1.py engine rather than creating a second gate-check engine.
The runner must not execute PROFILE_RUNTIME_V3, PACK_VALIDATION, S30, TRANSVERSAL_README, Contract Check, DB Regression or production actions.
Historical placement inside Validate LF Packs is not ownership authority.
Consumer-specific evidence qualification remains separately blocked until its reusable ownership contract is proven.
